paragraphs: Southland is a diverse leader in specialty infrastructure construction with roots dating back to 1900. The end markets for which we provide services cover a broad spectrum of specialty services within infrastructure construction. We design and construct projects in the bridges, tunnels, communications, transportation and facilities, marine, steel structures, water and wastewater treatment, and water pipelines end markets.

Southland is based in Grapevine, Texas. It is the parent company of Johnson Bros. Corporation, American Bridge Company, Oscar Renda Contracting, Southland Contracting, Mole Constructors and Heritage Materials. With the combined capabilities of these six primary subsidiaries, Southland has become a diversified industry leader with projects spanning North America in various end markets.

In the second quarter of 2023, Southland decided to discontinue certain types of projects in its Materials & Paving business line ("M&P") and sold assets related to producing large scale concrete and asphalt. M&P is reported in the Transportation segment. The Company will not be pursuing production of concrete and asphalt products for use on self-performed paving projects where the majority of the scope of work contains large-scale concrete and asphalt production or sale of asphalt and concrete products to third parties. This operational shift will allow the Company to better focus its resources on more profitable lines of business.
We manage Southland in two distinct segments: Civil and Transportation.

Our Civil segment operates throughout North America and specializes primarily in services that include the design and construction of water pipeline, pump stations, lift stations, water and wastewater treatment plants, concrete and structural steel, outfall, and tunneling.

Our Transportation segment operates primarily throughout North America and specializes primarily in services that include the design and construction of bridges, roadways, marine, dredging, ship terminals and piers, and specialty structures and facilities. Our Transportation segment is responsible for the construction of bridges and structures throughout North America, and other parts of the world, including many of the most recognizable bridges, convention centers, sports stadiums, marine facilities, and Ferris wheels in the world.

Our customers are a mixture of public and private entities. Our public sector includes certain federal agencies, state departments of transportation, local transit authorities, county and city public works departments, and utilities, while our private customers consist largely of the owners of industrial, commercial, and residential sites. The majority of both our public and private customers are located in the United States; however, we have large projects in Canada and the Bahamas, and experience in worldwide markets.

Management within each of our business segments is responsible for cultivating and maintaining successful long-term relationships with customers. Our local and corporate management teams build relationships with current and potential customers in order to better understand and serve their needs which benefits us in the competitive bid process.

We believe that our strategic relationships with customers will result in future opportunities. While relationships are important, we realize that future opportunities also require cost effective bids, as pricing is a key element for most construction projects.

Southland exists to build great things that shape our landscape and foster reliable infrastructure for future generations. Across our regional base of offices, Southland provides both Civil and Transportation infrastructure projects to a diverse base of public and private clients. These clients benefit from our market intelligence, local relationships, and our expert knowledge of design and construction.

● Self-Performance and Technical Experts. Our business model emphasizes self-performance of a significant portion of our work. This allows us to better manage costs by minimizing the use of third-party service providers, which can be more difficult to budget and can delay project schedules beyond our control. Our expertise in a wide range of technical areas allows us to form internal joint ventures which contribute to better cost management.

● Significantly Owned Equipment Fleet. Many of our services are equipment intensive. The cost of construction equipment, and in some cases, the availability of construction equipment, provides a significant barrier to entry into several of our businesses. We believe that our preference of ownership, rather than reliance on renting and leasing, of a large and varied construction fleet and maintenance facilities enhances our access to reliable equipment at a favorable cost and allows us to capture additional margin.

● Selective Bidding. We selectively bid on projects that we believe offer an opportunity to meet our profitability objectives or that offer the opportunity to enter promising new markets. In addition, we review our bidding opportunities to attempt to minimize concentration of work with any one customer, in any one industry, or in stressed labor markets. We believe that by carefully positioning ourselves in market segments that have meaningful barriers to entry, we can continue to be competitive.

● Maintain a Strong Balance Sheet and Bonding Capacity. We seek to maintain a strong balance sheet and bonding capacity to target varying sizes of contract work. This limits the number of competitors we bid against, as smaller, local companies are often not able to bid on larger or more technical projects.

Risks Relating to Southland's Business and Industry
We may lose business to competitors through competitive bidding processes.
Our Backlog is subject to unexpected adjustments and cancellations.
The loss of one or more customers could have an adverse effect on us.
We are subject to risks related to government contracts and related procurement regulations.
The timing of new contract delays, cancellations and termination of existing contracts may result in unpredictable fluctuations in our business.
We are vulnerable to the cyclical nature of the markets we serve.
Demand for our services may increase or decrease during economic recessions or volatile economic cycles, and a reduction in demand in end markets may adversely affect our business.
Adverse credit and financial market conditions could impair our, our customers' and our partners' borrowing capacity, which could negatively affect us.

The nature of our contracts subjects us to risks associated with delays and cost overruns, which may not be recoverable and may result in reduced profits or losses that could have a material impact on us.
We may incur higher costs to lease, acquire and maintain equipment necessary for our operations.
We use certain commodity products that are subject to significant price fluctuations.
Supply chain interruptions, including availability of materials, products or equipment, may have a negative impact on our ability to complete projects.
Some of our contracts have penalties for late completion.
Weather can significantly affect our revenue and profitability.
Climate change and related environmental issues could have a material adverse impact on us.
If we are unable to attract and retain qualified managers and skilled employees, our operating costs may increase.

We depend on key personnel and we may not be able to operate and grow our business effectively if we lose the services of any of our key persons or are unable to attract qualified and skilled personnel in the future.
Our employees work on projects that are inherently dangerous and in locations where there are high security risks, and a failure to maintain a safe work site could result in significant losses.
We may incur liabilities or suffer negative financial or reputational impacts relating to health and safety matters.
We are dependent upon suppliers and subcontractors to complete many of our contracts.
Our participation in joint ventures exposes us to liability and/or harm to our reputation for failures by our partners.
Employee, agent or partner misconduct or our overall failure to comply with laws or regulations could impair our ability to compete for contracts.
Changes in laws or regulations, or a failure to comply with any laws and regulations, may adversely affect our business, investments and results of operations.
We could be adversely affected by violations of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and similar worldwide anti-bribery laws.
During the ordinary course of our business, we may become subject to material lawsuits or indemnity claims.
Systems and information technology interruption and breaches in data security and/or privacy could adversely impact our ability to operate and negatively impact our results of operations.

Our inability to recover on contract modifications against project owners or subcontractors for payment or performance could negatively affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Public health crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, have adversely impacted, and could in the future adversely impact, our business, financial condition and results of operations.
In connection with acquisitions or divestitures, we may become subject to liabilities.
If we fail to integrate acquisitions successfully, we may experience operational challenges and risks, which may have an adverse effect on our business.

paragraphs: References to the "Company," "our," "us," "we," or "Southland" refer to Southland Holdings, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries. The following discussion and analysis contain forward-looking statements relating to future events or our future financial performance, which involve risk and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements. Please see the discussion regarding forward-looking statements and certain risks included under the "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Item 1A. Risk Factors" sections for a discussion of some of the uncertainties, risks, and assumptions associated with these statements. The following discussion and analysis present information that we believe is relevant to an assessment and understanding of our consolidated balance sheets, statements of cash flows, and results of operations. This information should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and the notes related thereto which are included in this Annual Report.

Southland is a diverse leader in specialty infrastructure construction with roots dating back to 1900. The end markets for which we provide services cover a broad spectrum of specialty services within infrastructure construction. We design and construct projects in the bridges, tunnels, communications, data centers, transportation and facilities, marine, steel structures, water and wastewater treatment, and water pipelines end markets.

Southland is based in Grapevine, Texas. It is the parent company of Johnson Bros. Corporation, American Bridge Company, Oscar Renda Contracting, Southland Contracting, Heritage Materials and Mole Constructors. With the combined capabilities of these six primary subsidiaries, Southland has become a diversified industry leader with projects spanning North America in various end markets.

Our Civil segment primarily operates throughout North America and specializes in services that include the design and construction of water pipeline, pump stations, lift stations, water and wastewater treatment plants, concrete and structural steel, outfall, and tunneling.

Our Transportation segment primarily operates throughout North America and specializes in services that include the design and construction of bridges, roadways, marine, dredging, ship terminals and piers, and specialty structures and facilities. Our Transportation segment is responsible for the construction of bridges and structures including many of the most recognizable bridges, convention centers, sports stadiums, marine facilities, and Ferris wheels in the world.

Both our Civil and Transportation segments continue to identify new opportunities to grow our business, and the future outlook of the end markets we serve remains positive. Although risk and uncertainty exist, including, but not limited to, the items addressed within our forward-looking statements and risk factors, we believe that we are well positioned to compete on new infrastructure projects in both the public and private sectors.

In both our Transportation and Civil segments, we have competitors within the individual markets and geographic areas in which we operate, ranging from small, local companies to larger regional, national, and international companies. Although the construction business is highly competitive, there are few, if any, companies which compete in all of our market areas, both geographically and from an end market perspective. The degree and type of competition is influenced by the type and scope of construction projects within individual markets. Equipment ownership and ability to self-perform across numerous disciplines are two of our significant competitive advantages. We believe that the primary factors

influencing competition in our industry are price, reputation for quality, safety, schedule certainty, relevant experience, availability of field supervision and skilled labor, machinery and equipment, financial strength, as well as knowledge of local markets and conditions.

Many of our competitors have the ability to perform work in either the private or public sectors. When opportunities for work in one sector are reduced, competitors tend to look for opportunities in the other sector. This migration has the potential to reduce revenue growth and/or increase pressure on gross profit margins.

We have seen an increase in demand for specialty construction projects in recent years at the federal, state, and local level. We anticipate the further spending on infrastructure related to economic stimulus spending including the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act that was passed on 2021, and other federal, state, or local initiatives.

We believe that the combination of our experience, reputation, and technical expertise are unmatched among companies of our size. This combination of skills has allowed us to pursue complex projects with fewer competitors.
Seasonality, Cyclicality, and Variability

The results of our operations are subject to quarterly variations. Much of the variation is the result of weather, particularly rain, ice, snow, heat, wind, and named storms, which can impact our ability to perform construction activities. These weather impacts can affect revenue and profitability in either of our business segments. Any quarter can be affected either negatively or positively by atypical weather patterns in any part of North America, or other areas in which we operate. Traditionally, our first quarter is the most weather-affected; however, this may or may not necessarily be true in future periods.

Our business may also be affected by overall economic market conditions, including but not limited to declines in spending by project owners, delays in new projects, by changes in client schedules, or for other reasons.

paragraphs: Southland 是專門基礎建設領域的多元領導者，其歷史可追溯至 1900 年。我們所提供的服務涵蓋基礎建設領域廣泛的專業服務。我們在橋樑、隧道、通訊、交通與設施、海洋、鋼結構、水與廢水處理以及水 pipelines 等終端市場設計並執行工程項目。

Southland 設立於德州 Grapevine。它是 Johnson Bros. Corporation、American Bridge Company、Oscar Renda Contracting、Southland Contracting、Mole Constructors 和 Heritage Materials 的母公司。透過這六家主要子公司結合的專業能力，Southland 已成為一個多元化的行業領導者，在北美各個終端市場執行項目。

在 2023 年第二季，Southland 決定停止其 Materials & Paving 商業線（"M&P"）中某些類型的項目，並出售與生產大規模混凝土與瀝青相關的資產。M&P 被歸類於 Transportation 分部。本公司將不再從事混凝土與瀝青產品的生產，用於自執行的鋪裝項目，其中大部分工作範圍包含大規模混凝土與瀝青生產，或向第三方銷售瀝青與混凝土產品。此業務轉型將使本公司能更專注於更具利潤的業務線。
我們將 Southland 管理為兩個區分的分部：Civil 與 Transportation。
我們的 Civil 分部在北美各地運作，主要專注於提供水 pipelines、泵站、提升站、水與廢水處理廠、混凝土與結構鋼鐵、出水口以及隧道設計與建設的服務。
我們的 Transportation 分部主要在北美運作，專注於橋樑、道路、海洋、疏浚、船隻碼頭與碼頭、以及特殊結構與設施的設計與建設。我們的 Transportation 分部負責在北美以及世界其他地區，包括許多著名的橋樑、會議中心、體育場館、海洋設施與摩天輪的橋樑與結構建設。
我們的客戶為公部門與私部門的混合組合。我們的公部門包括某些聯邦機構、州級交通部門、地方交通當局、縣市公共工程部門與電力公司，而我們的私部門客戶則主要為工業、商業與住宅地點的所有者。我們的公部門與私部門客戶大多位於美國；然而，我們在加拿大與巴哈馬有大型項目，並在國際市場有豐富經驗。
我們各業務分部的管理層負責培養與維護與客戶的長期成功關係。我們的本地與公司管理團隊與現有與潛在客戶建立關係，以更好地瞭解與服務其需求，這有助於我們在競爭性招標過程中的表現。
我們認為，我們與客戶的戰略關係將帶來未來的商機。雖然關係至關重要，我們也明白未來的商機同樣需要成本效益的標案，因為價格是大多數建設專案的關鍵要素。
Southland 存在的目的是建造能塑造我們景觀並為未來世代建立可靠基礎設施的偉大工程。在我們區域性的辦公室基地，Southland 向多樣化的公部門與私部門客戶提供民用與交通基礎設施專案。這些客戶可從我們的市場洞察力、當地關係以及對設計與建設的專業知識中受益。
● 自行執行與技術專家。我們的商業模式強調自行執行我們工作的重要部分。這使我們能更好地管理成本，透過減少使用第三方服務供應商，而這些供應商較難預算且可能延誤專案進度，超出我們的控制範圍。我們在廣泛技術領域的專業知識使我們能組建內部聯營公司，有助於更好的成本管理。
● 高度自有設備隊伍。我們許多服務皆為設備密集型。建設設備的成本，以及在某些情況下，建設設備的可得性，為我們多個業務領域帶來顯著的進入門檻。我們認為，我們偏好擁有而非依賴租賃與租借的大型且多樣化的建設設備與維護設施，能提升我們取得可靠設備的機會，並以有利成本進行，同時讓我們能捕捉額外的毛利。
● 選擇性投標。我們選擇性地對我們認為能達成我們利潤目標或能進入有前景新市場的專案進行投標。此外，我們也會審視投標機會，以試圖減少與任何單一客戶、任何單一產業或在勞動市場壓力下的專案集中度。我們認為，透過謹慎地定位在具有重大進入門檻的市場區段，我們能持續保持競爭力。
● 保持強勁的資產負債表與保證金能力。我們致力於維持強勁的資產負債表與保證金能力，以承接不同規模的合約工作。這會限制我們投標的競爭對手數量，因為較小的本地公司往往無法參與較大或技術性較高的專案投標。

paragraphs: 提及 "本公司"、"我們"、"我們"、"我們" 或 "Southland" 指的是 Southland Holdings, Inc. 及其合併子公司。以下討論與分析包含與未來事件或我們未來財務表現相關的展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述所預期的有重大差異。請參閱關於展望性陳述及某些風險的討論，包含 "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" 和 "Item 1A. Risk Factors" 節，以瞭解與這些陳述相關的一些不確定性、風險及假設。以下討論與分析提供資訊，我們認為這些資訊對評估與理解我們的合併資產負債表、現金流量表及營運成果是有關重要的。此資訊應與合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註包含於本年度報告中。
Southland 是專門基礎建設領域的多元領導者，其歷史可追溯至 1900 年。我們所提供的服務涵蓋基礎建設領域廣泛的專門服務。我們在橋樑、隧道、通訊、資料中心、運輸與設施、海洋、鋼結構、水與廢水處理以及水 pipelines 等終端市場設計與施工項目。

Southland 設立於 Texas 的 Grapevine。它是 Johnson Bros. Corporation、American Bridge Company、Oscar Renda Contracting、Southland Contracting、Heritage Materials 和 Mole Constructors 的母公司。透過這六家主要子公司結合的專業能力，Southland 已成為一個多元化的行業領導者，其項目遍及北美各個終端市場。
我們的 Civil 分部主要在北美運作，專長於提供包括水 pipelines、泵站、提升站、水與廢水處理廠、混凝土與結構鋼鐵、出水口及隧道施工等服務。
我們的 Transportation 分部主要在北美運作，專長於提供包括橋樑、道路、海洋、疏浚、船隻碼頭及碼頭、以及特殊結構與設施的設計與施工服務。我們的 Transportation 分部負責橋樑與結構的施工，包括世界上許多著名的橋樑、會議中心、體育場館、海洋設施及摩天輪。
我們的 Civil 與 Transportation 分部持續尋找新的機會來擴大我們的業務，我們所服務的終端市場未來展望仍然正面。雖然存在風險與不確定性，包括但不限於我們展望性陳述與風險因素中提及的項目，我們認為我們在公部門與私部門的新基礎建設項目中處於優勢位置。

在我們的 Transportation 與 Civil 分部，我們在運作的個別市場與地理區域中均有競爭對手，從小型地方公司到較大的區域性、國家性及國際性公司均有。雖然建設業非常競爭，但幾乎沒有公司能在我們所有市場區域，從地理與終端市場觀點來看，與我們競爭。競爭的程度與類型會根據個別市場內的建設項目類型與範圍而有所不同。設備擁有權與跨多個專業領域的自營能力是我們的兩大競爭優勢。我們認為影響我們產業競爭的主要因素
為價格、品質聲譽、安全、進度確定性、相關經驗、現場監督與技術勞工的可得性、機械與設備、財務實力，以及對當地市場與條件的瞭解。
許多競爭對手有能力在私人或公部門執行工作。當某一部門的機會減少時，競爭對手往往會尋找另一部門的機會。這種轉移可能導致營業收入成長減緩，並/或增加毛利率壓力。
我們觀察到近年來在聯邦、州及地方層面，對特殊建設專案的需求增加。我們預期將進一步投入與經濟刺激支出相關的基礎設施建設，包括2021年通過的《基礎建設投資與就業法案》，以及其他聯邦、州或地方的計畫。
我們認為，我們的經驗、聲譽與技術專業組合，在同規模的公司中是無可比擬的。這種技能組合使我們能夠在競爭對手較少的情況下，承接複雜的專案。
季節性、週期性與變動性
我們營運成果會受到每季變動的影響。許多變動是因天氣因素，特別是雨、冰、雪、高溫、風與命名風暴，這些天氣狀況可能影響我們執行建設工作的能力。這些天氣影響可能對我們的兩個業務分部的營收與獲利產生正面或負面的影響。任何一季都可能因北美或其他我們營運地區的異常天氣模式而受到正面或負面影響。傳統上，我們的第一季最容易受到天氣影響；然而，這在未來期間可能或可能不會持續。
我們的業務也可能受到總體經濟市場條件的影響，包括但不限於專案所有者支出減少、新專案延遲、客戶排程變更或其他原因。

與我們證券相關的風險
與南灘公司業務及產業相關的風險
我們可能透過競爭性招標程序失去客戶業務。
我們的待執行訂單可能因未預期的調整及取消而受影響。
失去一個或數個客戶可能對我們產生不利影響。
我們受到與政府契約及相關採購規範相關的風險影響。
新契約延遲、取消或現有契約終止的時機，可能導致我司業務產生無法預測的波動。
我司易受所服務市場週期性影響。
我司服務需求可能在經濟衰退或波動經濟週期中增加或減少，而終端市場需求減少可能對我司業務產生不利影響。
惡劣的信貸與金融市場條件可能影響我司、我司客戶及合作夥伴的借款能力，此情況可能對我司產生負面影響。
我司契約的性質使我們面臨與延遲及成本超支相關的風險，這些風險可能無法回收，並可能導致利潤減少或虧損，此情況可能對我司產生重大影響。
我司可能因租賃、購買新增或維護營運所需設備而產生較高成本。
我司使用某些大宗商品產品，這些產品價格可能出現顯著波動。
供應鏈中斷，包括材料、產品或設備的可取得性，可能對我司完成專案的能力產生負面影響。
部分合約對遲延完成有處罰條款。
天氣狀況可能顯著影響我們的營業收入與獲利能力。
氣候變遷及相關環境議題可能對我們造成重大不利影響。
若我們無法吸引並留住合格的管理階層與技術員工，營運成本可能增加。
我們依賴關鍵人員，若失去任何關鍵人員服務或未來無法吸引合格且具專業技能的人員，可能無法有效營運並拓展業務。
我們員工執行的項目本質上具危險性，且作業地點可能存在高安全風險，若未能維持安全的作業現場，可能導致重大損失。
我們可能因健康與安全事項而產生責任或遭受負面的財務或聲譽影響。
我們依賴供應商與分包商完成許多合約。
本公司參與合資企業，可能因合作夥伴之失敗而使本公司面臨責任及/或聲譽受損。
員工、代理人或合作夥伴之不當行為，或本公司未能遵守任何法律或法規，可能影響本公司爭取契約之能力。
法律或法規之變更，或未能遵守任何法律或法規，可能對本公司業務、投資及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司可能因違反美國反貪污法及類似全球反賄賂法規而遭受不利影響。
在本公司日常營運過程中，可能面臨重大訴訟或賠償請求。
系統及資訊科技中斷，以及資料安全及/或隱私權遭入侵，可能影響本公司營運能力，並對營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司無法從契約變更對項目業主或分包商之付款或履約要求中收回款項，可能對財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生負面影響。
公共衛生危機，例如 COVID-19 疫情，已對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響，未來亦可能產生不利影響。
